entries.title: Psalms 20:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob protect thee;

entries.title: Psalms 20:2
segments: May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

entries.title: Psalms 20:3
segments: Remember all thine oblations, and accept thy burnt-offering; Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 20:4
segments: Grant thee according to thy heart, and fulfil all thy counsels.

entries.title: Psalms 20:5
segments: We will triumph in thy salvation, and in the name of our God will we set up our banners. Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions!

entries.title: Psalms 20:6
segments: ¶Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; he answereth him from the heavens of his holiness, with the saving strength of his right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 20:7
segments: Some make mention of chariots, and some of horses, but we of the name of Jehovah our God.

entries.title: Psalms 20:8
segments: They are bowed down and fallen; but we are risen and stand upright.

entries.title: Psalms 20:9
segments: Save, Jehovah! Let the king answer us in the day we call.
